reviews.x: So far I've used these for sunscreen and lotion, and they work great.  No leaks, and easy to dispense the contents to virtually the last drop.  They're also easy to fill, and I've also had them in some relatively rugged conditions including pretty high heat, with no issues or leaks at all.

I LOVE these! They have a wide mouth for easy filling. So far they have not leaked at all!! I always have a hard time with liquids when traveling because they leak all over my bags. These cute little containers solve the problem! They are exactly what I was looking for. The only down side is that the dispensing nozzle is so good that with like toners it squirts a little more than I would want out. Would definitely buy again.

reviews.t: Do not put Paul Mitchell Super Skinny serum in this container!
reviews.x: I travel a lot an purchased these to replace some of my traditional travel bottles. So far, they've been good, with the exception of one that I used for Paul Mitchell Super Skinny Serum. There is some sort of chemical reaction that turned the serum into a hard gel, then the bladder separated from the cap and leaked all over. All of the other containers were fine (shampoo, conditioner, Ouidad serum, body lotion, etc.).

reviews.t: Great for your carry on bag
reviews.x: These work great to fit in your one quart baggie to get through TSA.  They're very easy to fill.  I use one for lotion, shampoo, conditioner, facewash, and hair styling gel.  I love the color coding to keep them straight.  Well made and should last a long time.  They don't hold a lot, but perfect for a few days.

Have had these for 7ish months and have used at least 2 on all trips since I purchased them. These are great quality containers and one holds 1.25 oz, which is a perfect amount for a 4-day trip. (I've actually made one filled with shampoo last me 6 days in Europe, showering frequently.) I've had absolutely no spillage issues and the different colors make it so I don't have to label the containers.  Everyone should use these to be a pinch more environmentally friendly :)
These are a very nice size.  They are squishy, so they pack well.  Hard to mark what is in them unless you use a Sharpie marker; however, they come in different colors, so that helps.

reviews.t: Versatile, small and MUCH easier to squeeze thicker products like conditioner for non-check bags
reviews.x: Nice small size and seem leakproof this far. Daughter had larger version yet tried this and also said great size for quart-sized baggie limitation if not checking bags.
Love the smaller size!  These are great for liquid items that you don’t need a large quantity. I use one to put hand lotion to carry around in my purse.

Super easy and convenient to use. I can pack my own products and these are just the right size. I previously got some that were a bit bigger and found that I didn't need that much to take along with me, I usually travel away for the weekend and sometimes up to a week. These were perfect for that, they're reuseable, easily cleaned, and nice to pack to make sure you stay within the 3-1-1 rule.

Even though they make travel size toiletries, you are limited to what those are (brand, type, etc.) and the shapes vary. It was like a game of Tetris trying to fit everything into the 1Qt clear plastic container. With these, I fill them with the same toiletries I use at home and they fit without issue.
Very small, just the right size for a weeks worth of product.  Have taken them on four trips, no leakage at all.  Easy to clean as well.  Different colors make it easy to differentiate product.
These are great for travel. Great for toner or an other fluids that are needed.
Perfect for shampoo, conditioner, lotion, body wash, etc.
they are cute, fits easily in pocket, and easy for traveling to put hand sanitizers in!

reviews.t: Do not buy. Waste of money.
reviews.x: After putting my beauty products in the bottles, the bottles morphed and deformed. One bottle fell apart completely. I haven't done anything to cause these bottles to warp, they have been sitting on my bathroom counter. I haven't even taken my trip yet so they have not been on a plane, just sitting in my bathroom.

reviews.t: Best containers for toiletries- my “FIND” of the year!
reviews.x: The bottles were a great find.  They are perfect to bring to the gym filled with shampoo, conditioner, lotion, shower soap, even toothpaste.  They never leak and are easy to fill from the bigger bottles at home. They save money as I no longer need to buy expensive travel size toiletries.

reviews.t: Great to have for hand sanitizer
reviews.x: They're colorful, they seal well, and most importantly, they are heat proof - last few plastic containers I had swelled like crazy and would shoot sanitizer everywhere if I left them in a hot car outside.
I used them for face cream, face wash, body lotion, shampoo, and anti-frizz cream. Holds enough for a week - at least! Went on a trip for 9 nights and came home with product leftover in all.
It leaked! Idk what product because I used all six of them but my bag was wet from products. Didn’t leak too much.
Sunscreen melted the rubber, otherwise works well for travel no leaks!
I used this for argon oil and it created the bottle to deform.

I have had these for a while now.  I loved them when I traveled more often, every few months or so.  BUT, I went on a trip recently and found that the product I put in several of these had dried up!  And NO I didn't check them before my trip because I didn't have this problem anytime before.  SO, now I will be tossing them.  I can't have something I can not count on.  They are great for traveling and they do not leak but I can't have my products wasted by drying up between trips!

These are great to carry in your purse or have on your desk or where ever you want to have sanitizer or what not handy.  I use them for sanitizer and gave one to each kid and my husband.  The only advice I have is to squeeze gently because if not you will get a big squirt of whatever is in your container.  Other than that they are great.  The size is really nice and holds a decent amount.  Just squeeze lightly and you'll be fine.

I love the leakproof system. my only complaint is that i put my make-up remover in one of the containers and it warped the bottle & began to leak so i'm assuming there is a chemical in the remover, that should not be utilized with the material of the bottles. They do give you a few chemicals to steer clear of when using them, i'll have to re-check.

I took these packed tightly in a crammed-full backpack on 7 planes, and not one hint of a leak - whether my backpack was carried on or checked. Easy to fill. Easy to use. PERFECT size - just because you're allowed 3 oz, doesn't mean I always want to take that much. Exactly what I was looking for

claims.text: Reviewers widely report the bottles do not leak, even under travel and rugged conditions.
Many praise the small size as ideal for short trips and fitting in a quart-sized carry-on bag.
Users find the bottles easy to fill and dispense, with wide mouths and good squeezeability.
Color coding and different colors help users tell products apart.
A few reviewers report serious problems: chemical reactions or warping/deformation of the bottles.
